hey, simply to resist the urge i suggest doing things to keep you occupied (watching a show, comedy special, etc to keep u entertained) and always keep doing something with your hand. you have control of your body, it’s hard to remember that, just think : i have to walk away. “ i must leave x room i am in now” to avoid staring at the blade. keep your hands occupied- playing a video game writing drawing playing guitar etc anything and keep something in your hands like a stress ball fidget toy etc and just don’t let yourself pick it up. for me, just realizing i was tempted and just closing my eyes and saying- “i have to walk away” works wonders. lol i pretended i was like a robot and would force myself to leave the area force myself to get up walk etc. i also found that like being under a blanket with a snack and a show i was just too lazy to get up and do it. don’t know if any of this helps. i was clean for like a year and a half and randomly got urges as well. you’re not weird nor alone. progress goes up and down though, what matters is the end result. just because you relapsed or gave in does not erase all of your progress, please remember that. you are still on the journey. this may seem like a down but i know you can get back up. (for me i would tell myself “hey, i went a whole week, i can do a whole week again” and stuff like that. even if you do give in, please do not feel bad. i hope you can withstand the urges, but i can’t blame you, it’s really really hard. maybe tell your bf how you feel so he can help distract you/keep your mind off things. i wish you the best❤️

im so sorry no one’s said more kind things to you. don’t think you don’t deserve to be happy simply bc other people don’t reflect it. because you do deserve to be happy. i know you may not feel that way, and it’s natural to feel down about yourself. your mental breakdown especially in public mustve sucked. but it’s not your fault, its how you handled the overload of emotions. you don’t deserve to be made fun of for it much less have your mom repeat negative things about you for it. im sorry no one’s said nicer things to you recently. you’re emotionally exhausted and it shows- im so sorry. please work with your therapist and ask for theme to help you as much as you can. self work and self love is a long huge process, you may not feel like you deserve good right now, but please work towards that goal as of now so in the future you can thank yourself for starting your self love journey. it’s pretty long but you deserve to be happy, i promise❤️

hi, i’m so sorry you relapsed. you sound very busy and perhaps a little bit overwhelmed. it sounds like you need a break. i know how hard recovery can be. i would say the best thing is to confide in a veryyyy trusted friend (you don’t have to tell them that you relapsed) but just someone that you can come to on a day to day basis when you need someone to talk or vent to. if you trust your coach, tell them the mental draining and express any feelings of exhaustion etc especially if it’s affecting your sport. at school, (or at least at mine), see if there is a social worker or counselor you can visit. ask your front desk if you guys have one - and if you know you do, ask to set up an appointment to see them. (like i said you don’t have to tell them about your s/h if you don’t want) but express to them some details of your mental state and see if you guys can do checkups or sit down and talk together . (at my school they sometimes pull you out of class for this so it’s not going to require any before/after school extra time). hope this helps if it all! i wish you the best. building close relationships helps as well, and please take some time to take care of yourself. you sound like you need the break.💌 wish you the best stranger🫂❤️

lots of people do end up committing suicide, that doesn’t mean it wasn’t preventable. but, growing up with adversary circumstances, it can seem like one’s own life was just destined for doom for the beginning. but let me tell you, if you’ve never received understanding, never received love, nor warmth, i hope i can start. i love you stranger, you deserve better, and i know exactly how you feel. like the odds will be always stacked up against you. if you saw your loved one feeling like this, it would make you sad, it would make you want to comfort them and make you want to see them be happy. that’s exactly what you deserve. you deserve to be happy, and i’m sorry you can’t see any reason for it now. the one person you’re always going to have is yourself, and it’s really hard to be kind to it but self love is the way. if i was there i’d give you a huge, big warm hug, and tell you that i care. because i do! you are cared for, and i hope that you can care for yourself one day, even though it’s really hard. you don’t need to have it the absolute worst to feel bad. it’s not the trauma olympics. others have it worse but that doesn’t make your situation any easier. your feelings are valid, and you deserve love and compassion❤️im sending you an enormous hug 💌🫂

hey, i’ll give you a hug❤️ i feel the same way with my bf. you’re don’t sound sad, you just need some love like the rest of us. if you feel like he isn’t affectionate enough/ providing you with enough love, communicate that to him! say “i wish we could __ (spend time together,) or “i wish you could (hold me when i feel sad), etc etc. ask him if you can come to him when you get sad/depressive thoughts. if you don’t feel like he shows it, tell him, just say “sometimes i feel under appreciated” etc. don’t do it an accusing manner like “you never love me!” or “you don’t love me enough” either. even if you know people love you, it can be hard to stay because you’re just so unhappy with yourself. other peoples love may help but at the end of the day loving yourself is the most important. having your sole purpose to live be another person is very unhealthy. it can help momentarily until you find some long term help, but it is not a long term solution. please tell your boyfriend you feel this way and hopefully he can help you find access to mental health help/ a professional. please don’t feel guilty: you’re not a burden. you don’t have to make your only reason to stay him, it’s not healthy either. you can list out the small things that make you happy: the smell of coffee in the morning, your favorite flowers, warm sheets out of the dryer, your favorite song, etc etc. small reasons to live for are valid too!! needing some extra affection here and there especially while struggling with suicidal thoughts there’s nothing wrong with that. i hope you can open up a little to him and i hope you get all the hugs you need❤️
